title: Pure Kewl Tune
summary: Pure Kewl Tune cards with generic Tuners and staples. Every Kewl Tune monster is a Tuner that allows a Tuner in your hand to be used as Synchro Material, and because most effects lock you into Tuners for the turn, the entire Extra Deck consists of Synchro Tuners.

summary.title: Starters
points: Kewl Tune Cue Special Summons a Tuner from the hand, Deck, or GY when Normal Summoned.
Kewl Tune Mix (Level 2) searches a non-Level 2 Kewl Tune monster on summon and destroys an opposing monster when used as Synchro Material.
Kewl Tune Reco (Level 3) searches a non-Level 3 Kewl Tune monster on summon and destroys an opposing Spell/Trap when used as Synchro Material.
Kewl Tune Synchro searches any Kewl Tune card and immediately Synchro Summons a Tuner Synchro Monster, and can be activated up to twice per turn.

summary.title: Opening: Kewl Tune Cue or Kewl Tune Synchro
steps: Normal Summon Kewl Tune Cue to Special Summon Kewl Tune Mix or Kewl Tune Reco from the Deck, searching Kewl Tune Clip or another Kewl Tune monster.

Synchro Summon Level 4 Kewl Tune Track Maker (which searches a Kewl Tune card such as JJ "Kewl Tune" or Kewl Tune Synchro) or Level 6 Kewl Tune Loudness War using a Tuner on the field and a Tuner in the hand.
Extend with JJ "Kewl Tune"'s extra Tuner Normal Summon and Kewl Tune Synchro to climb into Kewl Tune RS, Kewl Tune Remix, and Level 10 Kewl Tune B2B.

summary.title: Hand-Synchro & Opponent's-Turn Tuning
summary.text: Because Kewl Tune monsters can use a Tuner in the hand as Synchro Material and trigger extra removal effects when sent to the GY as Synchro Material, every Synchro Summon doubles as interaction. Kewl Tune Clip Special Summons itself during the opponent's Main Phase to immediately Synchro Summon and banishes a card from their Extra Deck as material, while Fydraulis Harmonia Special Summons itself when an opposing monster activates its effect.

summary.title: Control
points: Kewl Tune B2B raises opposing monsters' Levels and responds to an opposing monster effect by bringing back a Tuner and Synchro Summoning.
Kewl Tune Crackle, made with Clip + Tuners, banishes cards from the opponent's Extra Deck and returns when it leaves the field.

Kewl Tune RS negates a face-up card during either Main Phase, Kewl Tune Loudness War protects your other Tuners and copies a Kewl Tune Synchro Material effect on the opponent's turn, and Kewl Tune Remix Tributes itself on their turn to add one Tuner, summon another, and Synchro Summon.
Zalen the Shackled Dragon negates a chained card, while Coral Dragon and Deep Sea Prima Donna round out the all-Tuner Extra Deck.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: JJ "Kewl Tune" grants an extra Tuner Normal Summon each turn and Tributes a Tuner to search or Special Summon a Kewl Tune monster.
Kewl Tune Playlist applies a Kewl Tune monster's Synchro Material effect in the GY and returns it to the hand.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: Kewl Tune Rotary is Forbidden in the TCG, and the page's going-second Tatsunoko package is omitted.
